title: The Uncharted Current
author: C. M. Brightwater
blurb: Jonah Ravensworth, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
